pool.text: The cathedral was burnt out during a dispute in the city.
The Ordinance made it mandatory to write laws and oral customs.
The nightly adoration of the Blessed Sacrament started and spread throughout France.
An animal escaped from the Barnum and Bailey circus during their stay.
American soldiers arrived to set up textile factories and repair shops.
The Wilson Bridge over the Loire was officially opened in the city.
The city hosted the Congress of Tours, seeing the creation of the party.
Heavy air raids by Allied forces devastated the area around the station.
Pierre Patout succeeded Lefèvre as the architect in charge of rebuilding.
The devotion was approved and the Feast of the Holy Face declared.
The François Rabelais University was founded and centred on the Loire bank.
The Wilson Bridge collapsed in the city before being rebuilt later.
Jean Germain became mayor and made debt reduction his primary goal.
